localizedValues.name: Gazebo
localizedValues.description:
The Horsethief Lake waterfront gazebo sits at the eastern point with a dramatic backdrop of Horsethief Butte and the lower cliffs descending to the far lake shore. The classic hexagonal gazebo with its sloping grass approach makes for a natural amphitheater and memorable space for company picnics, family reunions, or weddings (special activity permit may be required).

The gazebo rental includes the approach slope, surrounding grass flats, and immediate beachfront. The gazebo can accommodate up to 6 guests and has a combined interior and exterior capacity of up to 80 guests. It is about 75 yards from the day use parking lot. Parking is shared with the public and fills up quickly on summer weekends. There are two self-pay stations in the parking lot to purchase Discover Passes.

This unique location played host to the Columbia Basin Fish Accords signing ceremony between the United States and Columbia Basin tribes. https://www.critfc.org/fish-and-watersheds/fish-and-habitat-restoration/columbia-basin-fish-accords/
